title: Lemon Drop Salt Nic E-Liquid – Lemon Lime 30ml
description:
Description
Experience the zesty burst of citrus with every inhale of this lime-infused lemonade flavour, delivering a refreshing and tangy twist that dances on your taste buds.
Lemon Drop Salt is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Lemon Drop Salt E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
